title: cassia rowleana
intro: Cassia rowleana, commonly known as East Indian cassia or cinnamon tree, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antidiabetic activities. The therapeutic actions of Cassia rowleana include pain relief, wound healing, and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. Additionally, its extracts have been shown to exhibit anti-cancer and anti-hypertensive properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
